reasoning:
Key challenge: send_sms doesn't write household_id/template_id/params. So we can't use send_sms alone to carry same details. Options: append record directly via store.append_jsonl with full fields (new id via format_sms_id(next_number(...)), queued_at via now()). R2 says gateway sends every line in the file. R1 says send_sms appends and returns record; but we need extra fields. So plan: script reads outbox via sent_messages() or store.read_jsonl, reads status via delivery_status(), filters failed, for each appends a new record reusing phone/text/household_id/template_id/params, new id, new queued_at. Also audit entry optional.

Also append audit entry {"event": "sms_resend", "actor": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "ref": new id, "at": ...} — optional; R10 says may follow pattern. Include it.

Note: next_number must be recomputed after each append or track increment. Use sent_messages() each iteration or track.
